lessons.title: Break Contact
lessons.text: Move a screening force through the enemy line and exit rather than fight to destruction.

lessons.title: Movement plan
lessons.text: Your designated exit is the northern edge. Move toward it and preserve movement capacity.

lessons.title: Fire plan
lessons.text: A damaged unit may be more useful withdrawing than firing another volley. Protect rear armor while retreating or advancing.

lessons.title: Review the tradeoffs
lessons.text: Check the exit controls and mission scores. Destroying enemies is not the only route to success.

lessons.title: Review
lessons.text: Review the battle record and retry to improve your practice.

mission.name: Break Contact
mission.summary: Exit through the northern edge and preserve your force.
